info.title: zxvd JSON-RPC
info.description: zxvd-rpc/1: JSON-RPC 2.0, one request per line over a 0600 UNIX socket owned by the same user (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_rpc.h). Errors: -32700 parse, -32600 invalid request or batch, -32601 unknown method, -32602 bad params, -32603 internal, -32000 libzxv status: error.data = {status: ZXV_E_* number, name: its symbolic name, class: USAGE|REFUSED|FATAL|SYSTEM}, -32010 peer request refused or failed (message says why), -32012 the method's feature is off (zxvd_ext.h X4: start zxvd with --enable FEATURE or call features.set), -32011 AIPI call refused or failed (message: the AIPI_ERR_* name and what it means), -32020 payment step refused (message says why: netting, passkey or escrow, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_pay.h). 64-bit integers (entry ids, *_minor results) travel as decimal strings. zxvd refuses to start against libzxv older than ABI 1.3.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: The protocol name and every method name this zxvd serves.

methods.name: zxvd.version
methods.summary: App version, protocol and the libzxv ABI version and feature mask.

methods.name: zxvd.shutdown
methods.summary: Stop the daemon after this reply; the socket file is removed.

methods.name: swarm.state
methods.summary: The live swarm: hardware budget, levels, cycles, market, settlement spine (pay_ledger postings, fees, halt), audit, quest, companion budget and last answer tag, network and update status. Same object as the window's /api/state.

methods.name: swarm.ask
methods.summary: Ask the companion. With a model installed it answers under the tokens-per-cycle budget gate and the answer is tagged; with none, shorthand is read back.

params.name: prompt
params.description: UTF-8, at most 4095 bytes

methods.name: model.info
methods.summary: The model slot: loaded, can_generate, name, arch, n_layers, n_vocab and one status line.

methods.name: notes.list
methods.summary: Recent notifications and the unread count.

methods.name: notes.mark_read
methods.summary: Mark every notification read.

methods.name: net.command
methods.summary: Vinea peer network: off, lan, online, peer IP:PORT, share C S, want RES UNITS MAX, sell RES UNITS PRICE NODEID. Off by default.

params.name: command
params.description: one command line

methods.name: net.peers
methods.summary: The routing table's contacts (zxv_net_host.h U9, zxvd_rpc.h V1). Every contact answered a signed message, so its NodeID is verified. Each row is joined with the peer's mesh-book account when there is one. Empty while networking is off.

addr.description: a.b.c.d:port, or "" for a non-IPv4 address

last_seen_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds of the last message

in_book.description: The mesh book has an account for it

member.description: Admitted to the commons by the owner

held.description: Units the peer issued that this node holds

receivable.description: Units delivered to the peer on credit

count.description: Contacts in the table (the list holds at most 256)

methods.name: net.offers
methods.summary: What the owner shares, the open wants, and the receipts still waiting on the other side (zxvd_rpc.h V2): a sell offer the buyer has not accepted, or a buy the seller has not committed.

max_price.description: The most this node pays for one receipt

want.description: buy: the want slot it reserves from; -1 for sell

methods.name: player.card
methods.summary: The owner's Player Card (sicily.h S2/S3, zxvd_rpc.h V3): the tier the measured inputs earn, each input with its source, the next tier's thresholds and which are missing, and the perks. Bond, uptime and giving have no source on this node yet and are reported as 0 with the reason. Tiers give no priority, discount or credit.

methods.name: peer.ask
methods.summary: Ask another node (found over UDP, then a TCP session: X25519 + ML-KEM-1024 key exchange, ML-DSA-87 on both sides) and pay its price plus the 0.08889% assurance fee from the peer wallet (kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_peer_host.h). Needs networking on. The daemon's loop waits while the request runs.

params.name: peer
params.description: IPV4 or IPV4:PORT (default port 8723)

params.name: prompt
params.description: UTF-8, at most 4096 bytes

params.name: max_price_minor
params.description: the most this node will pay, VFV minor units, before the fee

methods.name: peer.serve
methods.summary: Start answering other nodes over TCP for price_minor VFV minor units per answer, or stop when price_minor is absent. Off by default; needs networking on.

params.name: price_minor
params.description: VFV minor units per answer; absent stops serving

methods.name: peer.status
methods.summary: The peer book: wallet, fee buckets, sales, purchases, the last 16 settlements, and whether the book verifies.

methods.name: update.check
methods.summary: Run one signed update check now (the only check while not online).

methods.name: currency.enable
methods.summary: Enable an ISO 4217 currency in the owner's books (libzxv zxv_ccy_enable_cap).

params.name: code
params.description: ISO 4217 alpha code, e.g. USD

methods.name: ledger.open_account
methods.summary: Open an account (libzxv zxv_ledger_open_account_cap).

params.name: name
params.description: at most 63 bytes

params.name: currency
params.description: an enabled currency

params.name: kind
params.description: holder (default; never below zero) or issuer

methods.name: ledger.post
methods.summary: Post a balanced transfer in minor units (libzxv zxv_ledger_post_cap). Amounts must be integers; fractions are refused, never rounded.

params.name: from
params.description: account id

params.name: to
params.description: account id

params.name: amount_minor
params.description: > 0 and at most 2^53-1 (libzxv ZXV_AMOUNT_MAX): a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: currency
params.description: the accounts' currency

params.name: reference
params.description: unique, at most 35 bytes (e.g. EndToEndId)

methods.name: ledger.balance
methods.summary: Rail balances of an account: DEBIT 555, CREDIT 777, EQUITY 888, in minor units.

params.name: account
params.description: account id

methods.name: ledger.accounts
methods.summary: Every account with its name, currency and kind.

methods.name: ledger.entries
methods.summary: One account's journal, oldest first.

params.name: account
params.description: account id

methods.name: ledger.check
methods.summary: Verify the books: per currency debits equal credits, no holder below zero, exact shadow equals the triple ledger. A failure poisons the context.

methods.name: swarm.earnings
methods.summary: The swarm's earnings in the owner's books (docs/ZXVD.md, zxvd_rpc.h E1-E5). After every settled market cycle the owner's account is set to the Financial capital (SWC) the owner's models hold, times rate_minor, by one balanced posting from or to the swarm market account. The accounts are null until the first settled cycle. With a books file (--books), accounts brought back at start keep their balance: the run's first cycle is the base and later cycles post only the change (E5).

currency.description: Earnings currency (default VFV, a private unit with 2 minor units; --earnings-ccy)

rate_minor.description: Minor units per SWC (--earnings-rate); a bookkeeping rate, not a market price

resumed.description: The accounts came back from the books file (E5)

methods.name: mesh.books
methods.summary: Settled peer requests in the owner's books (zxvd_rpc.h S1-S4): sales, purchases and the 0.08889% fee the node paid, in VFV, with the demo float posted as 'mesh float' when a purchase needs more than the wallet account holds. The accounts are null until the first settled request.

methods.name: books.file
methods.summary: Where the owner's books are saved (zxvd_rpc.h F1-F6): an append-only file of SHA-256-chained records, replayed at start. saved is false when the books live in memory only (no --books).

saved.description: A books file is in use

head.description: SHA-256 chain head after the last record

writable.description: False after a failed write: the books are read-only until zxvd restarts (F5)

methods.name: jurisdiction.get
methods.summary: The jurisdiction bridge's settings (zxvd_rpc.h J1-J5), kept in the books file.

market.description: J2: closed clearing (default) or the open batch-auction market

standard.description: J3: the accounting standard reports will follow; "" = not chosen

in_effect.description: J5: recorded only; no report adapter or open market is wired to the settings yet

methods.name: jurisdiction.set
methods.summary: Change any of market, standard and country (J4); the others keep their values. The change is saved in the books file before it applies; an unchanged setting writes nothing.

schema.description: J2: closed clearing (default) or the open batch-auction market
J3: the accounting standard reports will follow; "" = not chosen

market.description: J2: closed clearing (default) or the open batch-auction market

standard.description: J3: the accounting standard reports will follow; "" = not chosen

in_effect.description: J5: recorded only; no report adapter or open market is wired to the settings yet

methods.name: aipi.put
methods.summary: Store bytes (a Z-Wasm module, Z-Contract text, data) in this node's in-memory blockstore as a raw block, pinned; returns its CID. Give exactly one of hex and path (a file zxvd reads, at most 1 MiB). Offline node: nothing is announced (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_aipi.h Z1-Z2).

params.name: hex
params.description: the bytes as hex, at most 8000 bytes

params.name: path
params.description: a file to read instead of hex

params.name: private
params.description: seal the block at rest with this node's key (default false)

methods.name: aipi.get
methods.summary: AIPI_GET: the bytes a CID names, from the local blockstore, re-hashed before they are returned. At most 65536 bytes; a larger block is refused, not cut (Z4).

methods.name: aipi.publish
methods.summary: Publish a function descriptor (intent fn) and return its function CID. The rules of docs/AIPI.md section 3 apply: checker and cert need a checker export, cert a certifier, quorum is for the mesh only.

params.name: module
params.description: CID of the Z-Wasm module

params.name: contract
params.description: CID of the Z-Contract text the calls must keep

params.name: fuel_max
params.description: most fuel one run may use (> 0)

params.name: local_only
params.description: privacy LOCAL: the descriptor is stored sealed and the function never leaves this node (default false)

params.name: deterministic
params.description: the same input always gives the same output (default true); only deterministic public calls are memoised

methods.name: aipi.execute
methods.summary: AIPI_EXECUTE on this node: run a published function in the Z-Wasm sandbox under its contract and fuel_max, or answer from the memo of earlier results (route cache). Offline (A3): code that is not in the local blockstore fails with AIPI_ERR_OFFLINE.

params.name: args
params.description: the Z-Wasm call ABI: up to 8 signed 64-bit integers

params.name: private
params.description: the input is private: never memoised (default false)

methods.name: aipi.status
methods.summary: The AIPI node: offline, blockstore use, call counts and the sandbox's counters.

methods.name: chat.me
methods.summary: The owner's chat identity (zxvd_chat.h C1, C3, C7): the NodeID (SHA-256 of the ML-DSA-65 key), whether records are saved beside the books, how many are held, and who the owner follows.

methods.name: chat.post
methods.summary: Sign and save a public post, or a reply when reply_to names a held record (C5, C6). Text is 1..1024 bytes of UTF-8 with something besides spaces. Records stay on this device: there is no exchange with peers yet.

schema.description: the id of a held record to reply to

methods.name: chat.react
methods.summary: Sign and save a reaction (an emoji or a word, 1..32 bytes of UTF-8) to a held record (C5, C6).

schema.description: the id of a held record

methods.name: chat.follow
methods.summary: Follow or unfollow a NodeID (C7). The newest FOLLOW record decides; a repeat of the current state writes nothing.

methods.name: chat.feed
methods.summary: The held posts, best first, at most 50, ranked by what each adds over the others (social_feed.h F2-F5, the Interaction Surplus Framework) with a small freshness term. No likes, reply counts or views are read by the ranker.

methods.name: chat.thread
methods.summary: A held record and its replies in (Lamport, id) order (C5).

schema.description: the id of a held record

methods.name: iso20022.render
methods.summary: Render an ISO 20022 message with libzxv (zxvd_pay.h P1): pacs.008.001.09 or camt.053.001.08. Every value is checked by libzxv and a camt053 must reconcile (opening + booked entries = closing). Rendered only: nothing is sent. Needs the books open (-32603 otherwise).

params.name: fields
params.description: text fields; libzxv says which a kind takes

params.name: amounts
params.description: minor units of fields.ccy, which amounts and entries need

params.name: entries
params.description: camt053 statement entries

methods.name: card.check
methods.summary: Check a card number's check digit for one of the platform's networks (Damm for phoenix, Luhn for dragon, Verhoeff for thunderbird). A PAN is 2..19 decimal digits (else -32000 ZXV_E_ARG). Nothing is issued or authorized.

methods.name: netting.open
methods.summary: Open a multilateral netting cycle in one ISO 4217 currency (libzxv on the cbank cb_net engine; zxvd_pay.h P3). In memory: lost when zxvd stops. At most 8 cycles are held, open or closed. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.add
methods.summary: Add a participant to an open cycle (at most 64). Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.submit
methods.summary: Submit a payment between two participants of an open cycle. Idempotent on payment_id: the same payment again is accepted and books nothing; the same id with other parties or another amount is -32000 ZXV_E_DUPLICATE. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: netting.close
methods.summary: Close a cycle and compute each participant's net position; the positions sum to zero. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.positions
methods.summary: The net positions of a closed cycle (-32020 while it is open). Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.list
methods.summary: The cycles held, without positions. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.drop
methods.summary: Destroy a held cycle, open or closed. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: passkey.register
methods.summary: Register a device-bound ML-DSA-65 passkey (COSE alg -49) from its WebAuthn-shaped authenticator data (ident.h id_rp_register; zxvd_pay.h P4). In memory, at most 32. Behind the "passkeys" feature (off at start, -32012 while off).

params.name: authenticator_data
params.description: with the attested credential

methods.name: passkey.verify
methods.summary: Verify an assertion for a registered passkey (ident.h id_rp_verify): the signature over the authenticator data and the client data hash, the relying party, user presence, user verification and an increasing signature counter. A refusal is -32020. Behind the "passkeys" feature (off at start, -32012 while off).

params.name: client_data_hash
params.description: SHA-256 of clientDataJSON

methods.name: ledger.hold
methods.summary: Hold funds in escrow (zxvd_pay.h P5): one posting from the payer to the holder account "escrow: <CCY>" (opened with the first hold in that currency), reference "escrow N to T". Saved in the books file like any posting. Behind the "escrow" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

params.name: from
params.description: the payer's account

params.name: to
params.description: the payee's account, same currency

methods.name: ledger.release
methods.summary: Pay a held hold to its payee (reference "escrow N release"). Only the owner's call releases: there are no release conditions or counterparty signatures. Behind the "escrow" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: ledger.refund
methods.summary: Return a held hold to its payer (reference "escrow N refund"). Behind the "escrow" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: ledger.holds
methods.summary: Every hold, read back from the escrow accounts' entries, and each escrow account's balance against what its open holds add up to. Answers while the escrow feature is off.

unmatched.description: escrow entries that are no hold's step

methods.name: features.get
methods.summary: Every feature switch (zxvd_ext.h X3-X7): its name, whether it is on, whether it is regulated, and its method groups. All start off; with a books file, features.set changes are saved and replayed at start.

regulated.description: X5: moves or records money, credit, securities or identity data that law regulates somewhere; for tests or a licensed deployment

saved.description: X7: true when switch changes are saved in the books file

methods.name: features.set
methods.summary: Turn one feature on or off (X3, X6: its engine keeps its state); saved in the books file when there is one (X7). Methods of an off feature answer -32012.

saved.description: X7: true when the change was saved in the books file

methods.name: cards.status
methods.summary: The charge-card issuer (kernel/src/cardnet): network, counts, and whether the ledger balances (C1) and the receipt chain verifies (C2). Answers while the feature is off.

methods.name: cards.check_pan
methods.summary: Check digits of a card number: Luhn, Damm and Verhoeff, and the Dragon/Phoenix/Thunderbird network it is valid for (C5), if any. A check digit is not authority. Answers while the feature is off.

methods.name: cards.iso8583_parse
methods.summary: Read an ISO 8583:1987 message (0100/0110/0200/0210/0400/0410, the fields cn_iso8583.h supports) into its MTI and fields. Answers while the feature is off.

methods.name: cards.issuer
methods.summary: Set up this run's issuer once: the network, the 3-digit issuer code (default 001) and a flat merchant fee per settled charge (default 0). The PAN seed comes from the OS (or 'seed'); it is never returned. In memory only. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: seed
params.description: for tests: the issuer seed instead of OS randomness

methods.name: cards.open_account
methods.summary: Open a holder account (at most 8). Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

due.description: unix seconds of the due day, while a statement is unpaid

methods.name: cards.account
methods.summary: A holder account: held, unbilled, billed and owed amounts (charge card: due in full, no interest). Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

due.description: unix seconds of the due day, while a statement is unpaid

methods.name: cards.issue
methods.summary: Issue a card for a priceable capital form bound to the holder's ML-DSA-65 public key (at most 16 cards). Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: entropy
params.description: for tests: PAN entropy instead of OS randomness

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: cards.reissue
methods.summary: Replace a card: a new PAN for the same account and form, the old card revoked in the same step; optionally a new holder key. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: cards.freeze
methods.summary: Freeze (default) or unfreeze a card. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

methods.name: cards.card
methods.summary: A card by index or by PAN (no key material). Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

methods.name: cards.challenge
methods.summary: The canonical bytes the holder signs with ML-DSA-65 (context ZXV-CARDNET-ARQC-v1) for an authorization request. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: form
params.description: capital form (cardnet.h cn_form_t)

params.name: atc
params.description: application transaction counter: must increase per card (1..65535)

params.name: un
params.description: terminal unpredictable number (EMV 9F37)

params.name: terminal_id
params.description: exactly 8 printable characters, or declined as format

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: exactly 15 printable characters, or declined as format

params.name: currency
params.description: default 555 (rail 555); any other is declined

params.name: time
params.description: request time, signed; default the clock

methods.name: cards.authorize
methods.summary: The funding decision: verify the holder signature and the card's state, limits and counter, and approve (placing a hold) or decline. A decline is a result with its ISO 8583 field 39 code, not an error. Send the fields with 'sig', or the EMV-shaped container 'emv' (cn_emv.h) that carries them. At most 32 authorizations per run. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: form
params.description: capital form (cardnet.h cn_form_t)

params.name: atc
params.description: application transaction counter: must increase per card (1..65535)

params.name: un
params.description: terminal unpredictable number (EMV 9F37)

params.name: terminal_id
params.description: exactly 8 printable characters, or declined as format

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: exactly 15 printable characters, or declined as format

params.name: currency
params.description: default 555 (rail 555); any other is declined

params.name: time
params.description: request time as signed; required with the fields

params.name: sig
params.description: ML-DSA-65 holder signature; required with the fields

params.name: emv
params.description: E1 container instead of the fields and sig

methods.name: cards.capture
methods.summary: Settle an approved authorization in full: DR 555 / CR 777 legs (and the flat fee leg) and one hash-chained receipt. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

methods.name: cards.reverse
methods.summary: Release the hold of an approved, not yet captured authorization (ISO 8583 0400). Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: cards.refund
methods.summary: Refund a captured authorization in full: the mirror legs and a refund receipt. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: cards.pay
methods.summary: A holder payment, applied to billed statements first; it clears delinquency once the bill is paid. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

due.description: unix seconds of the due day, while a statement is unpaid

methods.name: cards.advance
methods.summary: Advance the clock: close statement cycles and mark accounts past their due day delinquent. The amount owed never grows. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: passkeys.status
methods.summary: The passkey relying party: credential counts and open challenges. Answers while the feature is off.

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: passkeys.register_begin
methods.summary: Start a registration: a single-use 32-byte challenge valid for 300 s. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: user
params.description: user handle

params.name: rp_id
params.description: default zxv.id

params.name: origin
params.description: default https://<rp_id>

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: passkeys.register_finish
methods.summary: Finish a registration with the authenticator's authenticatorData (attested credential data, COSE alg -49 ML-DSA-65, attestation 'none'). Stores the public key only. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: auth
params.description: authenticatorData, 2033 bytes as hex

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: passkeys.auth_begin
methods.summary: Start a login: a single-use challenge; with 'user', the user's live credentials for the rp are listed in 'allow'. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: rp_id
params.description: default zxv.id

params.name: origin
params.description: default https://<rp_id>

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: passkeys.auth_finish
methods.summary: Finish a login: rebuild clientDataJSON from the challenge and origin, verify the ML-DSA-65 signature over authenticatorData || SHA-256(clientDataJSON), and require the signature counter to increase. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

params.name: auth
params.description: authenticatorData

params.name: now
params.description: default: the clock

methods.name: passkeys.list
methods.summary: Registered credentials (revoked ones included), optionally one user's. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

methods.name: passkeys.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a credential: it stays listed and never logs in again. Answers -32012 while the feature is off.

methods.name: vault.deposit
methods.summary: Record an assurance fee collected outside these books (E3): it is issued into the four buckets by the exact split of pay_assure.h B1 (reserve floor, V-Bill dividend pool, bounties, regenerative), then the vault sweeps a third of the reserve share (svault.h S1): moved to its cash, or kept in the reserve when the vault is at its cap (S2). Feature 'vault' (regulated, off by default); in-memory economy (zxvd_econ.c E1-E6). An engine refusal is -32020 with the engine's status name.

params.name: fee_minor
params.description: the fee in Vino minor units, at least 1

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: the current time)

methods.name: vault.buy
methods.summary: The vault buys V-Bills from a holder with its swept cash (svault.h S3): qty = min(max_qty, room under the 1/3 cap, cash / price) in one posting; 0 buys nothing. Feature 'vault' (regulated, off by default); in-memory economy (zxvd_econ.c E1-E6). An engine refusal is -32020 with the engine's status name.

params.name: seller
params.description: the selling holder

params.name: price_minor
params.description: Vino minor units per V-Bill, at least 1

params.name: max_qty
params.description: at most this many (default unlimited)

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: the current time)

methods.name: vault.first_loss
methods.summary: The vault's V-Bills absorb a loss first (svault.h S5): min(loss, held) are redeemed at par; the rest is reported uncovered. Feature 'vault' (regulated, off by default); in-memory economy (zxvd_econ.c E1-E6). An engine refusal is -32020 with the engine's status name.

params.name: loss_vbills
params.description: the loss in V-Bills

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: the current time)

methods.name: vault.status
methods.summary: The vault and the fee buckets: reserve, cash, V-Bills outstanding and held, cap and room, the redemption floor reserve / (N - h) (null with no outside holder), and the lifetime counters (S6). Answers while the feature is off.

methods.name: vault.check
methods.summary: The vault's audit (svault.h S6), the ledger's invariants, and the solvency test reserve * floor_den >= floor_num * (N - h) * backing (S4). Answers while the feature is off.

params.name: floor_num
params.description: default 1

params.name: floor_den
params.description: default 1

params.name: backing
params.description: Vino minor units per V-Bill (default 100)

methods.name: swap.deposit
methods.summary: Vino of a holder enters these books (E3): issued to the holder's Vino account, opened with its V-Bill account on first use (at most 32 holders). methods.name: zenny.mint
methods.summary: Mint a Zenny chip (zenny.h Z1/Z2): legs valued exactly at their prices, a V-Bill leg with weight > 0 mandatory, chips = value / kappa exactly. zxvd signs as the minter (E4); a co-minter's signature and a custodian's attestation never verify here, so BILATERAL chips and commodity legs are refused, as are margin and credit. Posting the legs is the caller's (Z6). Feature 'zenny' (regulated, off by default); in memory; 'Zenny' has no trademark clearance. An engine refusal is -32020 with the engine's status name.

params.name: minter
params.description: the minter's id

params.name: co_minter
params.description: BILATERAL only

params.name: kappa
params.description: reference units per chip, at least 1

params.name: rules
params.description: zenny.h Z1 bits: 1 allow rebalance, 2 bilateral, 4 margin, 8 credit, 16 allow top-up

params.name: nonce
params.description: default: the next of zxvd's own counter

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: the current time)

methods.name: zenny.quote

params.name: prices
params.description: one {num, den} per leg

methods.name: zenny.decompress
methods.summary: Tap to pay: decompress c chips into their legs exactly, valued at the batch prices, with the 0.08889% fee recorded in a disposal receipt (zenny.h Z5). Paying out the legs is the caller's (Z6). Feature 'zenny' (regulated, off by default); in memory; 'Zenny' has no trademark clearance. An engine refusal is -32020 with the engine's status name.

params.name: chips
params.description: c

params.name: prices
params.description: one {num, den} per leg

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: the current time)

params.name: ack
params.description: drain up to this seq

params.description: default 0

params.description: default 0

params.name: failed_challenges

params.description: default 0

methods.name: grants.appeal
methods.summary: G2: a dispute-funnel ruling that clears the masked reasons for one subject in one epoch.

params.name: subject
params.description: participant id

params.name: epoch
params.description: the epoch (not below the current): a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: mask
params.description: reason bits 1..127 (uptime 1, dropped 2, routing 4, audit 8, fraud 16, volume 32, stake 64)

params.name: sig
params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)

methods.name: grants.distribute
methods.summary: G3: one grant per epoch: B = floor(pool * cap / price) barrels split by weight (largest remainder), paid pool -> reserve; every recipient must be in good standing or nothing is granted. A pool that cannot pay one whole barrel is refused (GRANT_ERR_EMPTY): nothing is minted.

params.name: lot
params.description: an open, unattested lot

params.name: price
params.description: Vino per barrel, > 0: a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: recipients
params.description: 1..32 recipients (about 20 fit one request line)

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: zxvd's clock): a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.name: grants.attest
methods.summary: G5: a listed underwriter's signature over (lot, count, underwriter, expiry) backs a lot until expiry. A signature proves who signed, not that any oil exists.

params.name: lot
params.description: lot id

params.name: count
params.description: the lot's outstanding barrels: a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: underwriter
params.description: a listed underwriter key id

params.name: expiry
params.description: unix seconds, above now and the last expiry: a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: sig
params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: zxvd's clock): a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: lot

params.name: sig
params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: zxvd's clock): a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.name: estate.setup
methods.summary: Start the estate engine (estate.h), once per run: the owner's key (living veto), guardians and k, attestors, the court and the jurisdiction gateway. Bookkeeping only: nothing is moved.

params.name: owner
params.description: the owner (Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, hex)

params.name: guardians
params.description: the guardians (1..5 Ed25519 public keys of 32 bytes, back to back, hex)

params.name: k
params.description: approvals needed, 1..guardians

params.name: attestors
params.description: the death attestors (1..4 Ed25519 public keys of 32 bytes, back to back, hex)

params.name: court
params.description: the court (Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, hex)

params.name: gateway
params.description: the jurisdiction gateway (rulings) (Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, hex)

params.name: wait
params.description: seconds from report to confirmation (default 0): a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: release
params.description: seconds from confirmation to key release (default 0): a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.name: estate.manifest
methods.summary: E2/E4/E5: the inheritance manifest, exact fractions summing to 1. common: the will's heirs [{id, num, den}], only while alive. faraid: the heirs (faraid.h F1) and their ids. forced: jurisdiction (FR built in), children ids, gifts [{id, num}] over will_den. faraid and forced are ADVISORY and need a gateway ruling before distribution.

params.name: enclave
params.description: the rule set

params.name: heirs
params.description: common: 1..16 heirs

params.name: husband
params.description: a husband survives

params.name: wives
params.description: wives (0..4)

params.name: father
params.description: the father survives

params.name: mother
params.description: the mother survives

params.name: sons
params.description: sons

params.name: daughters
params.description: daughters

params.name: others
params.description: any other relative survives (refused: not modelled)

params.name: ids
params.description: faraid: one id per person: husband or each wife, father, mother, each son, each daughter

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: forced: two letters, e.g. FR

params.name: children
params.description: forced: the children's ids

params.name: gifts
params.description: forced: the will's gifts to non-children

params.name: will_den
params.description: forced: the gifts' common denominator: a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.name: estate.faraid
methods.summary: Faraid shares (faraid.h) for husband, wives, father, mother, sons and daughters as exact fractions, and with amount_minor each person's exact part (largest remainder; the parts sum to the amount). A COMPUTATION of one common majority treatment, NOT A RULING: a qualified scholar or court decides.

params.name: husband
params.description: a husband survives

params.name: wives
params.description: wives (0..4)

params.name: father

params.name: mother
params.description: the mother survives

params.name: sons
params.description: sons

params.name: daughters
params.description: daughters

params.name: others
params.description: any other relative survives (refused: not modelled)

params.name: amount_minor
params.description: an amount to split: a JSON integer or a decimal string

params.name: sig

methods.summary: Start account recovery control (recovery.h), once per run: the root anchor, five guardians, the gateway and the first device. Days are 86400 seconds.

params.name: root
params.description: the account's root anchor (Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, hex)

params.name: guardians
params.description: exactly 5 guardians (1..5 Ed25519 public keys of 32 bytes, back to back, hex)

params.name: gateway
params.description: the gateway (Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, hex)

params.name: first_device
params.description: the first device key (Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, hex)

params.name: timelock
params.description: seconds a claim waits without a veto (default 259200): a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.name: recovery.claim
methods.summary: R1: open a claim for a new device key; the account is view-only until it ends. Rate-limited; every guardian is notified (counted, not delivered).

params.name: new_key

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: zxvd's clock): a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.summary: R3: an active (old) device vetoes: the claim then needs 4 approvals and 14 days.

params.name: sig
params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)

methods.name: recovery.cancel
methods.summary: R3: an active device cancels the claim outright.

params.name: device

params.name: sig
params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)

params.name: sig
params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)

methods.name: recovery.device_revoke

params.name: sig
params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)

params.name: now
params.description: unix seconds, the engine's tick (default: zxvd's clock): a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.name: recovery.gateway

params.description: Ed25519 signature over the bytes the matching *.message call returns (64 bytes, hex)
